title: KorBa — Elektroniczny korpus tekstów polskich z XVII i XVIII w.
institution: Instytut Języka Polskiego, Polska Akademia Nauk (IJP PAN)
notes: KorBa (korba.edu.pl) is the largest corpus of historical Polish (1601-1800, ~27M segments), TEI P5 encoded with transcription/transliteration layers and rich metadata; maintained by the Institute of Polish Language, Polish Academy of Sciences (IJP PAN) with IPI PAN, PI Włodzimierz Gruszczyński, National Humanities Programme (2013-2023). The manually annotated subcorpus is downloadable under CC BY-SA (the legacy hostname korba.clarin-pl.eu no longer resolves). The Renascor Corpus working snapshot contains three collections of this project (KorBa_Polish, KorBa_Polish_full17c and KorbaText, the plain-text layer whose titles match KorBa's published text list), merged here as one edition. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
license_note: Includes CC-BY-SA-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
